line: Send a voice message instead of a text — let them hear you smile.
paragraph: Someone meant to do it later and did it today instead. Send a voice message instead of a text — let them hear you smile. It took almost nothing — a minute, a look, a small reach across an ordinary day. Nobody asked for a speech. The room, or the street, or the quiet between two people, shifted half a degree warmer. That was enough. They went on with whatever came next, lighter for having refused to skip it.
